name: Working Memory Maintenance
description: Persistent activity sustaining representations over seconds. Prefrontal cortex neurons show delay-period activity during memory-dependent tasks. Implements short-term storage via recurrent synaptic dynamics and sustained firing.
computational_signature: dynamics: dX/dt = -X/tau + input(t), sustains X during delay
key_references: Goldman-Rakic, P. S. (1995). Cellular basis of working memory. Neuron, 14(3), 477-485.

Compte, A., Brunel, N., Goldman-Rakic, P. S., & Wang, X. J. (2000). Synaptic mechanisms and network dynamics underlying spatial working memory in a cortical network model. Cerebral Cortex, 10(9), 910-923.
empirical_evidence: PFC and parietal neurons maintain firing during delay period (Goldman-Rakic). Lesions to PFC impair delayed response tasks. Network models with recurrent connectivity can sustain activity. Debate: is maintenance via persistent firing, short-term synaptic plasticity, or attractor dynamics?
